bagPolicy.summary: Bags that do not meet the specified requirements must be returned to the patron's vehicle or stored in a locker. Parental and medical bags are allowed inside but are subject to search and size restrictions.
bagPolicy.note: Parental/Medical bags are allowed inside (subject to search) and cannot exceed a 12" x 14" dimension.

parking.note: The CURE Insurance Arena offers 3,500 parking spaces across four main lots, with costs varying by event. Parking is first come, first serve, and ADA accommodations are available in Lot #1. Lots open two hours before events, and alcohol consumption is prohibited.

rideshare.note: Use Lot 2 at Gate A for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Pickup drivers must arrive 30 minutes before the event ends to enter Lot 2. If your driver misses that cutoff, arrange another pickup location.

concessions.note: CURE Insurance Arena offers a variety of food and drink options including Chickie's & Pete's famous Crabfries, grilled cheese from Just Cheese, and Black Angus Grill's burgers and hot dogs. Specialty drinks include Voodoo Ranger IPA and Casamigos Tequila.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All three gates (A, B, and C) are accessible, and anyone with mobility challenges can be dropped off at Gate A. Escorts and wheelchairs are available from Guest Services at Gate A (door 1), though staff and wheelchairs can't stay with you during the event. The Gate A elevator serves all levels; the Accessibility Hotline is 609-656-3205.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once a guest leaves the Arena during an event, there is no re-entry permitted unless another ticket is purchased.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The CURE Insurance Arena Box Office can reissue or reprint your tickets if you bring proof of purchase.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at CURE Insurance Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
